# TrailForge 峰途
> Outdoor gear reference storefront demonstrating production SEO + GEO patterns.

Site: https://example.com (set SITE_URL)
Note: Google Search / AI Overviews do NOT use llms.txt. This file is for other agents, tools, and documentation discovery.

## Primary pages
- [Home](/): Brand + featured products
- [All products](/products): Full catalog listing
- [About](/about): Organization entity
- [GEO Audit](/audit): Checklist scorer for local routes

## Categories (answer-first buyer's guides)
- [徒步鞋](/categories/hiking-shoes)
- [冲锋衣](/categories/jackets)
- [登山包](/categories/backpacks)
- [配件](/categories/accessories)

## Guides
- [第一次徒步怎么选装备](/guides/first-hike-gear)
- [户外防水等级怎么读](/guides/waterproof-ratings)

## Machine-readable APIs
- GET /api/products
- GET /api/products/{slug}
- GET /api/facts/{slug}  — citation-friendly product facts
- GET /api/health
- GET /api/audit?path=/products/{slug}
